text:
Ava: Quick thought — can we try switching the weekly triage (Wed 11:00) to a hybrid format? Proposal:
- 25m sync for blockers/backlog triage
- 20m async "digest" posted after the meeting listing owners + action items
- biweekly 30m deep-dive slot for thorny bugs / RFCs (opt-in)
Advantages: smaller sync, clearer async follow-up, easier owner handoff. Anyone opposed? Volunteers to own the digest template?

Ravi: +1. Also, where does PR review fit? Can we add a "PR urgency" line in the digest so reviewers know priorities?

Jordan: Support. Digest should include: owner, ticket link, status, blockers, next step. Also an immediate TL;DR line: "needs attention: yes/no".

Priya: I like the idea. Can we trial the async digest for two weeks before shortening the meeting? I can run the first two digests if we keep the meeting at 30m for this week.

Ava: Thanks — that sounds reasonable. Priya, if you can own the first two digests I'll leave meeting length unchanged this week and revisit after the trial. I'll also set a channel reminder.

Priya: I can do it. Draft template below: 
```
Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Top items:
- ISSUE-123 (owner: Jordan) — blocked by infra — next: triage 3/31
- ISSUE-456 (owner: Ravi) — PR open — needs review
PR urgency: high / medium / low
Action owners + ETA
Notes / blockers
```

Ravi: Nice template. Can we add a one-line label for "PRs needing review" with links? Makes it easy for folks scanning.

Jordan: Also propose we schedule the biweekly deep-dive as an "RFC review" slot in the rotation. 30m every other Wed should be enough for 1–2 RFCs.

Ava: Sounds good. Plan: Priya runs digest for two weeks, meeting stays 30m this week, then we consider moving to 25m if digest reduces real-time discussion. Can someone create a recurring calendar event for the biweekly deep-dive?

Jordan: I can add the calendar event and put up a quick Doodle/poll for deep-dive times.

reminder-bot: Reminder created — #eng: "triage digest draft" every Tue 10:00am — pings @Priya.

Ava: Thanks everyone. If there are no objections by EOD Friday I'll update calendar invites and post the digest template in #eng.

Ravi: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

Jordan: +1

Priya: Confirmed — I'll post the template and the first digest by Tue.

Ava: Great — marking this thread resolved for now. :tada:
